name: Microhouse one-chord
desc: One Abm7 chord clipped to a click and worked like a drum for eight minutes — the Kompakt move. iter(16) rotates the hit pattern one 16th every cycle so the chord slowly orbits the bar; a whisper of dotted delay gives it a shadow. The lpf barely moves. Hypnosis through discipline, nothing like the catalog's jack/organ/piano house gestures.

code.full: note("[ab2,b2,eb3,gb3]").struct("x ~ x ~ ~ x ~ x ~ ~ x ~ x ~ ~ ~").iter(16).add(note(${root})).s("sawtooth").attack(.003).decay(.08).sustain(0).release(.03).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.8, ${cut}).slow(32)).shape(.3).gain(saw.range(${gain}*.6, ${gain}).fast(4)).delay(.2).delaytime(.375).delayfeedback(.4).mask("<1 1 1 1 1 1 1 [1 0]>").orbit(4).play()
code.peak: note("<[ab2,b2,eb3,gb3] [ab2,b2,eb3,gb3] [ab2,b2,eb3,gb3] [ab2,db3,f3,gb3]>").struct("x ~ x x ~ x ~ x ~ x x ~ x ~ x ~").iter(16).add(note(${root})).s("sawtooth").attack(.003).decay(.07).sustain(0).release(.025).lpf(sine.range(${cut}, ${cut}*1.5).slow(16)).shape(.35).gain(saw.range(${gain}*.65, ${gain}).fast(4)).every(8, x=>x.jux(rev)).delay(.22).delaytime(.1875).delayfeedback(.45).orbit(4).play()
